title: Lamb Skewers with Smoky Glaze
description: Grilled lamb skewers smothered in a sweet and smoky glaze, perfect for a quick and easy gluten-free meal.

ingredients.name: Vibrant vegetable skewers (colorful bell peppers, onions, mushrooms)

instructions: Thread lamb cubes and vibrant vegetable skewers onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together smoky BBQ sauce and Canadian maple syrup.
Brush the lamb and vegetables with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
During the last 2 minutes of grilling, brush the skewers with the smoky glaze.
Let the skewers rest for 2 minutes before serving.
